report_name: Cisco Patches Three Critical Flaws in IOS XR Network Software

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-20274
vulnerabilities.description: An improper control of a resource during its lifetime vulnerability in Cisco IOS XR Software. An unauthenticated, remote attacker could exploit this by sending crafted packets to an affected device, potentially leading to remote code execution or denial of service.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-20279
vulnerabilities.description: An improper access control vulnerability in Cisco IOS XR Software. It can be exploited by an unauthenticated, remote attacker via crafted network traffic, potentially leading to remote code execution or denial of service.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-20212
vulnerabilities.description: A flaw in the S1HAL process in Cisco IOS XR Software that could be exploited by sending crafted input to an affected device. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute code or cause the process to crash, leading to a device reload.

indicators.name: Cisco IOS XR S1HAL Process Crash
indicators.pattern:
title: Cisco IOS XR S1HAL Process Crash
id: 2b9c1f8a-4d7e-4b0f-8c6d-9e3a1b2c3d4e
status: experimental
description: Detects unexpected process crashes of the S1HAL process on Cisco IOS XR devices, which could indicate exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-20212.
references:
  - https://www.techradar.com/pro/security/cisco-patches-three-critical-vulnerabilities-as-part-of-comprehensive-internal-security-review
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-05
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1499
level: high
logsource:
  product: cisco
  service: iosxr
detection:
  keywords:
    - 'Process S1HAL crashed'
    - 'syslog: S1HAL'
    - 'Traceback'
    - 'core-dump'
  condition: keywords
indicators.description: Detects logs indicating a crash of the S1HAL process on Cisco IOS XR devices, a potential indicator of compromise for CVE-2026-20212.

indicators.name: Cisco IOS XR Unexpected Device Reload
indicators.pattern:
title: Cisco IOS XR Unexpected Device Reload
id: 5e8f9a0b-1c2d-4e3f-a4b5-c6d7e8f9a0b1
status: experimental
description: Detects an unexpected device reload on a Cisco IOS XR device, which could indicate a denial-of-service condition caused by exploitation of vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-20274, CVE-2026-20279, or CVE-2026-20212.
references:
  - https://www.techradar.com/pro/security/cisco-patches-three-critical-vulnerabilities-as-part-of-comprehensive-internal-security-review
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-05
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1529
level: high
logsource:
  product: cisco
  service: iosxr
detection:
  selection:
    keywords:
      - 'System restarted'
      - 'Reload reason: kernel panic'
      - 'Reload reason: critical software exception'
  filter:
    keywords:
      - 'Reload reason: Admin issued'
      - 'Reload reason: reload command'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects logs indicating an unexpected device reload on Cisco IOS XR devices, a potential indicator of compromise for CVE-2026-20274, CVE-2026-20279, or CVE-2026-20212.
